title: System Configuration
connectedPlatformsDesc: Connect data sources and sync; drag to set report card order

analytics.visitorDesc: First-party, batched, idle beacons. Admin and site-owner sessions are excluded. Visitor id stays in the browser; the server stores hashes and uses proxy-trusted client IPs.
analytics.enablePreviewOn: New visits will be recorded. Signed-in admins and the site owner are not counted.
analytics.enablePreviewOff: New visits will not be recorded. Existing history stays.
analytics.disabledBanner: Collection is off: new visits are not recorded; historical data remains available
analytics.optOutDesc: Applies only to this browser. It does not change the site-wide switch above. While opted out, this browser will not send beacons or mint a visitor id.
analytics.optOutPreviewOn: This browser will not be counted
analytics.optOutPreviewOff: This browser follows the site-wide collection switch
analytics.pagesDesc: Views, true distinct visitors, and average engagement per page in the selected range
analytics.eventsDesc: Product events and unique users; sub-rows break down by target (tapp id, platform, music source, Journal source, …). Extend with trackProductEvent({ target }).
analytics.timezoneHint: Calendar-day buckets use the server process local zone (host/container clock + TZ if set; no fixed offset)
analytics.rangeCustomHint: Click a start day, then an end day. Hover previews the range. Max 365 days (daily aggregate retention). Views and similar daily rollups cover a full year; range unique-visitor detail is only kept ~90 days.
analytics.avgEngagementHint: Mean visible time for visitor×page days that reported engagement
analytics.topCountriesHint: Countries with the most unique visitors in the selected range (top 3 shown; hover for full detail)
analytics.approxBounceHint: Approximate: share of pageviews with no engagement credit — not a session bounce rate
analytics.allTimeVisitorsHint: Unique visitors are limited by ~90-day detail retention
analytics.dailyChartAria: Daily page views and unique visitors
analytics.emptyPages: No page data in this range
analytics.emptyReferrers: No external referrers in this range
analytics.importIntegrityFailed: Backup integrity check failed (file may have been tampered with, or was not exported from this instance). Re-export from this site and try again.
analytics.importMissingIntegrity: Backup is missing an integrity signature. Use a backup file exported from this site.
analytics.importConfirm: Import will REPLACE all current visitor stats (pages, events, referrers, visitor hashes). Only backups signed by this instance are accepted. Continue?
analytics.aiUsageDesc: Full-site AI calls (including admins and the site owner) by user, model, source, and day. Text, image, and speech are recorded — Tapp, scheduled jobs, Agent, reports, Agent persona, playground, and more. Filter by user or model; bars are calls (left axis), the line is tokens (right axis, independent scale).
analytics.aiUsageLoadFailed: Failed to load AI usage stats
analytics.aiUsageEmpty: No AI calls in the selected range
analytics.aiUsageEmptyUsers: No per-user usage in the selected range
analytics.aiUsageEmptyModels: No per-model usage in the selected range
analytics.aiUsageEmptySources: No per-source usage in the selected range
analytics.aiUsageChartAria: Daily AI calls and tokens trend chart
analytics.aiUsageBySourceDesc: Splits Tapp, scheduled jobs, Agent, reports, Agent persona, speech, playground, and other paths. Unlike visitor stats, admin calls are counted.
analytics.aiUsageFiltersAria: Filter AI usage by user, model, and source
analytics.aiUsageNote: Full-site cost ledger (tapp_ai_cost_ledger): includes admins and regular users. Text, image, and speech calls are recorded. Tokens are often estimates.

configBackupDesc: Export or import full settings, or reset to defaults
pinOptionGuideAria: Pin “{title}” guide (close only via the close button; draggable)
optionGuideFooterHint: These notes explain the option. Save when the page asks you to.
resetCurrentPageNone: Nothing to reset on this page
autoRefreshDescription: Schedule fetches for configured platforms (independent of report-page switch).
autoRefreshFrequencyDesc: Platform jobs are staggered to avoid contacting every external service at once.
autoRefreshSummary: {count, plural, one {Now: # configured platform} other {Now: # configured platforms}}, {hours, plural, one {every # hour} other {every # hours}}.
aiDesc: Text models by tier, image generation, and speech services
agentDesc: Persona, speaking, bots, scheduled tasks, skills, and memories.
labDesc: Low-poly generation, rigging, animation, and Web asset processing
tripoConnectionDesc: Independent from image AI; reference images are inputs to the 3D pipeline.
tripoEnabledDesc: Only enabled installations may create tasks that consume Tripo credits.
tripoApiKeyDesc: Stored only by the backend; never sent to browsers or embedded in models.
tripoFaceLimitDesc: 4,000–8,000 is recommended; 5,000 balances appearance and mobile performance.
basicDesc: Site URL, wallpaper, theme, and site metadata
oauthDesc: Add and configure GitHub, Google, Microsoft, and other login providers
musicDesc: Choose a music platform and playlist; disable to hide the player
networkDesc: Outbound proxy and Gemini / GitHub API mirror base URLs
federationDesc: Identity keys, instance policy, known instances, content filters, delivery queue, and inbound rate limits
federationInstancePolicyDesc: Inbound min trust, allowlist, and auto-registration — who may federate with this site
federationMinTrustInboundDesc: Inbound requests are rejected when the source domain is below this level. The default of 0 disables the trust floor. Raising it requires assigning a sufficient level to peer domains under Known instances.
federationAllowlistDomainsDesc: Leave empty to disable the allowlist. When non-empty, only listed domains may send inbound traffic; block rules still take precedence.
federationAutoDiscoverDesc: When enabled, domains not yet recorded are stored as Discovered (1) on first contact. When disabled they remain Unknown (0). Levels 2 and above are never assigned automatically.
federationKnownInstancesDesc: Manage trust level and block status per domain. Levels 2–4 are set manually; user follow relationships do not change instance trust. Blocked domains are refused for both inbound and outbound delivery.
federationNoInstances: No instances recorded. Entries appear after auto-registration or inbound activity.
federationListQueryToggleDesc: Narrow the list by keyword and filters
federationInstanceFilterAria: Filter by status or trust level
federationInstanceFilterEmpty: No instances match the current search or filter.
federationContentFiltersDesc: Inbound rejection rules applied by type and in order. Only inbound Activities are evaluated; matching traffic is refused.
federationFilterDescBlockActivity: Blocks inbound Activities whose type field matches. For example, blocking Announce reduces boost/repost spam.
federationFilterDescBlockKeyword: Matches keywords in the activity JSON/body (case-insensitive); a hit rejects the activity.
federationFilterDescRequireTrust: Rejects inbound traffic when the source domain trust is below the selected level. Independent of the instance-policy trust floor above; both can apply.
federationFilterFilterEmpty: No filters match the current search or filter.
federationAdvancedDesc: Cap inbound Activities per source domain; stacks with instance policy above. Defaults suit most deployments; too-strict values may reject legitimate peers.
federationRateMaxRequestsDesc: Maximum inbound activities per source domain within each window (default 100).
federationRateTrustedMultiplierDesc: For trust level ≥ 3, effective limit = max requests × multiplier (default 5).
federationKeysIdentityDesc: Your ActivityPub actor and signing key. Rotation replaces the RSA keypair and fans out Update(Person); remote peers must refresh your public key. ensure-keys never rotates silently.
federationKeysRotateConfirm: Rotate federation signing keys? Outbound signatures will use the new key. Peers that cached the old public key may reject deliveries until they refresh your actor document.
federationDeliveryQueueDesc: Pending, in-flight, failed, and cancelled outbound deliveries. Retry real failures; Remove stops and drops a row; Clear cancels in-flight and purges every finished row.
federationDeliverySearchPlaceholder: Search ID, domain, type, or error…
federationDeliveryFilterEmpty: No deliveries match the current search or filter.
defaultChangedApplyDetail: Click to set this option to {to} (was {from}). × only dismisses the notice.
federationDeliveryRetryFailuresConfirm: Re-queue every delivery that failed (not user-cancelled)?
federationDeliveryClearDesc: Cancel in-flight and purge dead letters
federationDeliveryClearConfirm: Cancel all pending/delivering items and delete every failed or cancelled row from the list? This cannot be undone.
aboutDesc: View Myriad version and project information
aboutTagline: A myriad of lights, in one place.
usersDesc: Admins and registered users, local registration toggle; OAuth links, installed apps, and online status
usersUnlinkConfirm: Unlink this OAuth account? The user will no longer be able to sign in with it.
usersUninstallTappConfirm: Uninstall {name} for this user? App files will be removed.
usersErrorCannotRestrictOwnerInstall: Cannot block app installs for the site owner.
usersErrorTappNotFound: That app install was not found.
usersPrimaryAdminOnly: Only the site owner can grant or revoke admin roles
usersPromoteReLoginNotice: Admin role granted. The promoted user must sign out and sign in again before admin APIs will accept their session.
usersDemoteImmediateNotice: Admin access revoked. It takes effect immediately for admin API checks.
usersLocalLoginRequiresOAuth: This user has no linked OAuth account; disabling local login would lock them out
usersDeleteConfirm: Permanently delete this user account? Their OAuth links, apps, and related data will be removed. This cannot be undone.
usersCreatePasswordRule: Use 8–128 characters, including at least one letter and one number.
usersUnlinkFailed: Could not unlink that sign-in method.
usersErrorUnlinkLast: Cannot unlink the only sign-in method. Set a password or link another provider first.
usersErrorDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account.
usersErrorRevokeSelf: You cannot revoke your own admin role.
usersErrorPrimaryAdminDelete: Only the site owner can delete administrators.
usersSearchPlaceholder: Search username, display name, email, or OAuth
updaterStatusDowngrade: Only older versions exist on this channel
updaterHintHealthy: No updates are available on this channel.
updaterHintUpdating: The system will be checked when it finishes.
updaterHintMaintenance: Exit maintenance mode below when ready.
updaterHintOffline: Check the update service URL and token.
updaterHintFirstRun: Check once to load the current version status.
updaterNoAvailable: You are up to date — no updates available.
updaterCheckStale: Check result may be outdated — rechecking…
updaterCheckStaleAction: Last check is too old — please check again
updaterDispatched: Update started (job {jobId}). Progress continues on the maintenance page.
updaterIrreversibleWarn: This update has irreversible data changes; you cannot simply roll back afterward.
updaterFreshnessAhead: {n, plural, one {# commit newer than current} other {# commits newer than current}}
updaterFreshnessBehind: {n, plural, one {# commit older than current} other {# commits older than current}}
updaterFreshnessDiverged: History diverged from current (target +{ahead}, current +{behind} commits)
updaterFreshnessUnknown: Cannot determine whether the target is newer or older than current
updaterChannelGroupDesc: Which update line to follow. Selecting saves immediately.
updaterChannelDevDesc: Preview-branch commits; can also install formal releases (e.g. v0.4.0). Least stable.
updaterCheckIntervalDesc: Set how often updates are checked automatically.
updaterAutoInstallDesc: Install new versions automatically; ask first for downgrades, conflicts, or changes that cannot be rolled back.
updaterProgressOnMaintenance: Once maintenance starts, full progress is on the maintenance page.
updaterConfirmUpgrade:
Update to {version}?

Takes an update snapshot, brief maintenance; failure rolls back.
updaterConfirmDowngrade:
⚠ Downgrade to {version} (current {current})?

DB may not reverse — data risk.
updaterConfirmRisk: ⚠ Cannot confirm safety (diverged, unknown, or irreversible). Data may be damaged. Proceed?
updaterConfirmComposeOverride: ⚠ The deployment compose file will be overwritten. It differs from the last version the updater wrote. Proceed?
updaterConfirmRollback: Restore pre-{version} state from snapshot? Later data will be lost.
updaterConfirmExitMaintenance:
Force-exit maintenance?

Only when the service is confirmed healthy.
updaterMaintenanceGroupDesc: Recovery tools when an update goes wrong.
updaterRescueContinueDesc: Restore from the pre-update snapshot and restart — safest recovery.
updaterForceExitDesc: Clears the flag only; does not restore data.
updaterSelfUpdateNeeded: Version {version} needs the updater upgraded to {minVersion}+ first.
updaterSelfUpdateConfirm: Upgrade updater to {version}? A few seconds; site unaffected.
updaterSelfUpdateConfirmAuto: Upgrade updater to the current registry tip? A few seconds; site unaffected.
updaterSelfUpdateDispatched: Updater upgrade to {version} started (was {previous}); continue the app update when it finishes.
updaterInfraGroupDesc: Updater components are not upgraded by the normal app update — trigger them here.
updaterInfraUpdaterDesc: Includes docker-guard / updater-gateway. Uses a separate path; finishes in seconds without stopping app containers.
updaterSelfUpdateReconnecting: Updater is restarting — connection may drop briefly; reconnecting…
updaterSelfUpdateStillPending: Updater upgrade still in progress or result not recorded yet; refresh this page later.
updaterTargetGroupDesc: Past releases or a specific commit. Not for daily use.
updaterDockerHubFallback: Discovering builds via Docker Hub (normal when the source repo is private or GITHUB_TOKEN is unset).
updaterSnapshotGroupDesc: A database snapshot is taken before each update; roll back here if needed. Snapshots sit on the same disk as the data and only the newest few are kept, so they are not a substitute for your own backups.
updaterNoDbSnapshotWarn: External database mode: this updater does not snapshot the database, so a failed update can only roll back the image version — data changes are not reverted.
updaterNoSnapshots: No snapshots yet. One appears after the first update.
updaterSnapshotLimitEnabledDescOn: Keep only the latest {n} (kept pins and snapshots in use by recovery are never auto-deleted)
updaterSnapshotLimitEnabledDescOff: Off: no count-based auto-prune; manual delete still works
updaterSnapshotLimitSavedPruned: {n, plural, one {Snapshot limit saved; removed # older snapshot} other {Snapshot limit saved; removed # older snapshots}}
updaterSnapshotLimitCounts: {eligible} auto-managed / limit {n}; {protected} kept or in use
updaterSnapshotLimitStillOver: Saved, but still {eligible} over the limit of {n} ({protected} kept/in use). If this persists, self-update the updater image from Update Management so retention is enforced.
updaterSnapshotLimitUpdaterOld: This updater does not report snapshot-limit fields — the image may be too old. Self-update the updater from Update Management; auto-delete will not work until then.
updaterDeleteSnapshotConfirm:
Permanently delete the snapshot for {version}?

This cannot be undone — you will not be able to roll back to this snapshot later.
updaterDeleteSnapshotInUse: This snapshot is needed for recovery and cannot be deleted yet.
updaterDeleteSnapshotLast: Cannot delete the only remaining snapshot.
updaterGroupAdvancedDesc: Operator tools. Not needed day to day.
updaterTransportBackend: Via backend (default, uses your admin login)
updaterTransportDirectHint: Emergency fallback for when the backend is down. The token stays in this page only and must be re-entered after a refresh.
updaterTokenRequiredDirect: Direct mode requires an UPDATE_TOKEN first
updaterErr401Admin: Admin login is required to manage updates
updaterErr403: This rescue action first requires `touch state/manual-override` on the host
updaterErr403Csrf: Security check expired (common after a backend restart). Refresh the page and try again
updaterErr409: An update job is already running; wait for it to finish
updaterErrServer: The update service reported an error: {msg}
updaterErrNotConfigured: The development stack does not start the updater by default. To test the full update flow, run the production compose stack or set MYRIAD_UPDATER_URL / UPDATE_TOKEN on the backend.
updaterErrUpstream: Cannot reach the updater (502/503). In dev, start it first: ./scripts/dev.sh start updater
updaterDriftWarn: This page is cached at version {build}, but the server runs {current}.
resetConfigDesc: Reset all configurations to default values. This action cannot be undone.
resetConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to reset all configurations? This action cannot be undone and will restore all settings to their default values.
exportConfigDesc: Export all settings, current administrator notification preferences, and browser preferences. The file contains sensitive API keys and tokens; store it securely.
importConfigDesc: Adaptively import settings from JSON; new options keep their current values and removed options are ignored.
importConfigSuccess: Settings imported and saved. Full page reload to load the complete state…
importConfigSuccessNeedsAttention: Settings imported and saved, but {count, plural, one {# item needs} other {# items need}} attention. Full page reload; details stay under “Backup & restore”…
restoreUnresolvedMediaTitle: {count, plural, one {# media item} other {# media items}} from the restored settings could not be found on this instance and {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} not bound
restoreUnresolvedMediaHint: These settings were kept as they were in the backup. Upload or choose the images again to show and protect them.
restoreSkippedSettingsTitle: {count, plural, one {# setting} other {# settings}} in the backup failed validation and {count, plural, one {was} other {were}} skipped; the current {count, plural, one {value was} other {values were}} kept
importConfigInvalid: Invalid configuration file. Please check the JSON format.
importConfirmMessage: Settings will be merged against the current version and the current administrator notification preferences restored. New options are preserved and removed options ignored. The page will fully reload after confirm. Review the preview below.
frontendCacheDesc: Local troubleshooting and maintenance tools; does not change server settings or sign you out
forceRefreshFrontendCacheDesc: Clears in-memory and local caches, Cache Storage, and Service Worker caches, then reloads the page. Theme, language, and sign-in stay.
forceRefreshFrontendCacheSuccess: Frontend caches cleared. Full page reload…
searchEmptyHint: Try multiple words (e.g. proxy sync) or a shorter keyword
partialSaveWarning: Some settings were saved, but later steps failed
loadConfigFailedDesc: Settings are unavailable. Check the connection and retry.
islandContentDesc: Choose what the top-right control island cycles through. Notifications stay under Notification settings.
siteIdentityDesc: Site name, blurb, and icon, plus whether visitors can install this site as a PWA
siteSeoDesc: Search/AI policy, keywords, share image, and AI-assisted copy
thirdPartyAnalyticsDesc: Connect Google Analytics / Umami; independent from the first-party visitor charts above — external reporting only
evocativeDesc: Bring static wallpapers to life with immersive visual effects
fieldEvocativeParallaxHint: Wallpaper shifts subtly with mouse movement / device tilt for 3D depth
fieldEvocativeDynamicBlurHint: Wallpaper sharpens when the pointer rests on empty space and blurs again over cards and content
fieldEvocativeRippleHint: Click on wallpaper to create water ripple distortion
fieldEvocativeFpsHint: Higher frame rate is smoother but uses more resources
fieldSiteFavicon: Site Favicon (also used for PWA install icons)
fieldSiteKeywordsHint: Comma-separated keywords written to the page meta keywords tag
fieldSiteOgImageHint: Public https URL for Open Graph / crawlers (data: and local uploads are not used). Prefer ≥1200×630, PNG/JPEG/WebP
fieldGoogleSiteVerificationHint: When verifying with an HTML tag in Search Console, paste the content value or the whole meta tag. Saved as google-site-verification on the page. After the site URL is set, submit /sitemap.xml.
fieldSiteNoindexHint: On: allow search engines to index. Off: pages emit noindex, nofollow — useful for private or not-yet-public instances
fieldSiteVisibilityPolicyHint: Controls whether search engines and AI (ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.) can discover and cite this site. Recommended: Allow AI citations for public sites.
seoOriginMissingHint: Site URL is not set. sitemap.xml will be empty and share links will not be absolute. Set the site URL above first.
visibilityAiCitationHint: Allow AI search citations; block training bots; serve /llms.txt
visibilityAiCitationHintBefore: Allow AI search citations; block training bots; serve
visibilityAiFullHint: No extra blocks for search or AI training/citations; serve /llms.txt
visibilityAiFullHintBefore: No extra blocks for search engines or AI training/citations; serve
fieldSiteAiIntroHint: 2–4 sentences for AI engines (who you are, what content). Written to /llms.txt. Falls back to site description if empty.
fieldSiteSeoReviewCadenceHint: Compares public copy to your own writing. Notifies you if it looks stale; Apply on the notice writes it. Never changes visibility on its own.
fieldSiteAiGenerateDesc: Generate description, keywords, and AI intro from your title and a short hint. Uses AI settings; falls back to templates if unconfigured.
fieldSiteAiGenerateHint: Fills the fields below — review, then save config.
fieldSiteAiGenerateHintPlaceholder: e.g. indie developer; tech blog and open-source projects
siteAiGenerateFallback: AI unavailable; template used — edit as needed
siteAiGenerateNeedTitle: Add a site title or a short hint first
siteAiGenerateTagHint: AI-generate this field; optional short hint (title or hint required)
siteAiGenerateDialogDesc: Uses your site title and current description as context. If there is no title, a hint is required. The hint tells the model who you are, what you do, and what to emphasize.
siteAiGenerateHintPlaceholder: e.g. indie developer; Rust and frontend; occasional game reviews
fieldPwaEnabledHint: When on, browsers can offer “Install app” and register a service worker for static assets
fieldGaMeasurementIdHint: GA4 Measurement ID (e.g. G-XXXXXXXX). After save, gtag loads and SPA navigations send page_view. Leave empty to disable. Staff sessions are not reported.
fieldUmamiWebsiteIdHint: Website ID (UUID) from the Umami dashboard. Required together with the script URL below.
fieldUmamiScriptUrlHint: Full tracker script URL. Cloud: https://cloud.umami.is/script.js; self-host often https://your-host/script.js. Host-only values get /script.js appended.
imageUploadHint: Enter a URL, or upload a local image (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/SVG/ICO, ≤512KB)
advancedDesc: Runtime diagnostics, memory saver, outbound proxy, API mirrors, settings backup/restore, and dangerous actions
memorySaverGroupDesc: Lower concurrent memory use on small hosts (~1 GiB). Default off uses the current bounded balanced profile; upgrades from older releases can change request limits.
memorySaverHint: A second notch below the bounded default: smaller chunk inflight, process caches, DB pool, password-hash concurrency, and video/audio peaks. Everyday messages still fit; large media should use chunked transfer, and lossless audio may reject sooner. Env MYRIAD_MEMORY_PROFILE can override. DB pool fully applies after backend restart.
preciseLocationGroupDesc: Weather uses IP geolocation by default and does not ask the browser for a precise fix.
preciseLocationHint: When on, weather asks the browser for location permission so city and forecast can be more accurate. When off, only IP geolocation is used and no permission prompt is shown.
agentOptionsDesc: Site persona, portrait, and speaking aloud.
agentChannelsDesc: Private-chat Work bots. Add one from the top right.
agentHeartbeatDesc: Have it do something on its own when the time comes.
agentSkillsDesc: Ways it has learned. Delete ones you do not need.
agentMemoryDesc: Things it remembers. Open a row to rephrase, or delete it.
agentPersonaHint: When on, Agent speaks with the site persona, keeps per-person mood and diary, and may speak after named events. When off, it only chats and does tasks.
agentPersonaNeedsLite: Lite is off: chat and name shuffle will not run. Proactive lines stay short and mood hints stay off.
agentPersonaNeedsPro: Enable the Pro tier in AI Config first — persona setup requires Pro.
agentPersonaEmptyLead: Go from tags to persona, pick an outfit style, then generate the portrait. This card will keep the portrait, a short summary, and current mood.
agentPersonaNeedsReports: Generate a persona after at least {need} platform reports. You have {count}.
agentPersonaDeleteConfirm: Delete the current persona? Mood and diary will be cleared too.
agentPersonaSpeechHint: Speak chat replies aloud. Off: mouth movement only.
enableProxyHint: External API requests will be sent through the proxy when enabled
proxyUrlHint: Supports HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5 proxy protocols
proxyUrlDisabledHint: Proxy is off (this address is unused while disabled). Clear the field to remove the saved proxy.
proxyBypassHint: Domains that should bypass the proxy, separated by commas. Recommended for domestic services like Bilibili
geminiBaseUrlHint: Leave empty for official endpoint, or enter a third-party proxy service URL
githubApiBaseUrlHint: Leave empty for official endpoint, or enter GitHub API mirror URL (Note: OAuth still requires official endpoint)
mcpTransportHint: The host deployment manages the gateway address, credentials and servers. Tool definitions cannot change them.
mcpGatewayUnavailable: The host has not configured an MCP gateway
mcpLocalUnavailable: Local MCP processes are disabled in production
mcpDesc: Manage external MCP connections for Agent. Production connects through a deployment gateway; local processes are for development only. Changes reload on save. Administrators only.
mcpFieldIdHint: Letters, digits, . _ - only; used as mcp.{id}.{tool}
mcpFieldArgsHint: Whitespace-separated; quote args that contain spaces
mcpFieldEnvHint: One KEY=value per line; secrets stay on the server
mcpFieldEnabledHint: New servers start disabled. Enabling runs the startup command; disabling terminates active calls and processes.
mcpFieldAutoRestartHint: Try to relaunch if the child exits unexpectedly
mcpFieldTrustAnnotations: Trust tool annotations from this server
mcpFieldTrustAnnotationsHint: Let read-only tools skip the confirmation prompt. Annotations are self-reported by the server, so enable this only for servers you control. Destructive tools always confirm.
mcpFieldMaxRestartHint: 0–50; stop auto-restart after this many tries
mcpEnableDesc: Start this server process and index its tools
mcpDisableDesc: Stop the child process; keep the config entry
mcpEditDesc: Change command, args, env, and other options
mcpDeleteConfirm: Delete MCP server “{id}”? Takes effect immediately on save.
mcpFormEditTitleDesc: Change command and environment for this server
mcpFormCancelDesc: Discard this edit without writing config
mcpValidateIdCharset: ID may only contain letters, digits, ., _, -
mcpInvalidConfig: This MCP config is invalid. Check the command and arguments.
mcpEmpty: No MCP servers yet. Click “Add server” to start.
runtimeDiagnosticsDesc: Run real database, storage, system/architecture, server-egress, version, and background-task checks, then export a credential-free diagnostic report.
runtimeDiagnosticsFederationGateAllowed: Egress is not in a blocked region
runtimeDiagnosticsStorageWritable: Data, cache, and Tapp directories are writable
runtimeDiagnosticsLocationVerified: Two direct sources agree (about {n} km apart)
runtimeDiagnosticsLocationSingleSource: Only one location source responded; result is not cross-verified
runtimeDiagnosticsLocationConflict: Location sources conflict; result is not considered trusted
runtimeDiagnosticsLocationUnavailable: Unable to verify server egress location over direct HTTPS
runtimeDiagnosticsVersionMismatch: Frontend {frontend}, backend {backend}. Reload the page or inspect the deployment.
processLogsExportDesc: Download recent warnings and errors from all available processes. Local development reads backend and frontend logs; deployments read core Docker service logs. Best-effort redaction is applied, but the report may still contain usernames, URLs, IP addresses, or third-party error content.
processLogsExportEmpty: Report downloaded; no warnings or errors were found
processLogsExportPartial: Report downloaded; some processes could not be read
processLogsExportFailed: Failed to export the process error report
processLogsExportUnavailable: The running system components do not support log export yet. Update or restart them, then try again.
runtimeDiagnosticsRecentFailures: Failures in the last {n, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
placeholderWallpaperUrl: Direct image URL, 302 redirect, or JSON API with url/image field
placeholderSiteTitle: Myriad - A myriad of lights, in one place.
placeholderSiteDescription: A myriad of lights, in one place.
placeholderGoogleSiteVerification: Paste the token or the full meta tag
savedSuccessRuntimeReload: Configuration saved; runtime hot-reloaded (no page reload needed)
savedSuccessHardReload: Configuration saved. Full page reload to apply changes…
hardReloadPreparing: Configuration saved; preparing full page reload…
aiProviderHint: Select AI service provider to show corresponding configuration
aiLlmDesc: Standard, Lite, and Pro text models. Lite and Pro fall back to Standard when off.
aiLiteModelDesc: Low-cost tier for light, high-frequency tasks
aiLiteEnableDesc: When off, Lite tasks fall back to Standard
aiLiteProviderHint: May differ from Standard; keys live in Providers above
aiProModelDesc: High-quality tier for complex reasoning and writing
aiProEnableDesc: When off, Pro tasks fall back to Standard
aiProProviderHint: May differ from Standard; keys live in Providers above
aiVendorsDesc: Add sources like login methods. The same vendor can have more than one. Models and speech pick from this list.
webSearchDesc: Used by Work-mode web search. TinyFish is preferred when this key is set; otherwise Gemini grounding is used. Visitors never fill this in.
tinyfishApiKeyHint: Search is free, but a key is still required. Sign up at agent.tinyfish.ai; no credit card. Clear the field and save to delete; a mask left as-is keeps the stored key.
aiVendorSetupPortalDesc: Sign in and go to the API keys page.
aiVendorSetupCreateDesc: Create an API key and copy it right away.
aiVendorSetupFillDesc: Put the key in API Key below.
aiVendorSetupAzureCreateDesc: Copy the key and endpoint from Keys and Endpoint.
aiVendorSetupAzureFillDesc: Key goes in API Key. Endpoint goes in Base URL.
aiVendorSetupCompatiblePortalDesc: Use a host that speaks OpenAI-compatible /v1.
aiVendorSetupCompatibleCreateDesc: Copy the API key from that service.
aiVendorSetupCompatibleFillDesc: Fill API Key and Base URL below.
aiVendorSetupOllamaPortalDesc: Install Ollama and start it on this machine.
aiVendorSetupOllamaFillDesc: API Key can be any placeholder. The URL defaults to localhost.
aiVendorSetupTencentCreateDesc: Create and copy SecretId and SecretKey.
aiVendorSetupTencentFillDesc: Fill the two fields below and pick a region.
aiVendorSetupAgoraPortalDesc: Open your project and Conversational AI.
aiVendorSetupAgoraCreateDesc: Copy the App ID, certificate, and REST Customer ID / Secret.
aiVendorSetupAgoraFillDesc: Fill App ID, certificate, Customer ID, and Secret. Speech still uses MiniMax.
aiImageDesc: Generate images; size is set per request
speechServiceDesc: Read-aloud and recognition. Pick an audio-capable provider above.
speechOpenRouterTtsHint: OpenRouter does not currently list official OpenAI TTS models. Transcription works; pick OpenAI for official speech.
speechMinimaxAsrHint: MiniMax reads aloud with speech-2.8-turbo by default. Listening still uses Tencent Cloud, OpenAI, or Gemini if one of those is configured.
agoraConvoEnabledDesc: Long-press the mic to join a live RTC conversation. Needs MiniMax speech and a public OpenAI-compatible model.
agoraConvoHint: App ID and certificate mint RTC tokens. Customer ID/Secret call the Conversational AI join API. TTS uses your MiniMax provider.
platformDescYoutube: Public channel stats and recent uploads
platformDescPsn: Trophies, trophy level, and recent games
discordOAuthSuccess: Discord data authorization succeeded. Tokens saved and platform enabled.
discordOAuthAppMissing: Add and enable a Discord app under OAuth login first. Data authorization reuses that application.
bangumiCredentialMissing: Enter a Bangumi Username or Access Token before enabling and saving Bangumi.
platformSetupFillDesc: Paste the values into the form below, save, then enable the platform.
platformSetupGithub1Desc: Open your GitHub profile and copy the username.
platformSetupGithub2Desc: Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens. Optional, raises rate limits.
platformSetupBilibili1Desc: Open your space page; the number after space.bilibili.com/ is the UID.
platformSetupSteam1Desc: Register a domain on the Steam Web API Key page and copy the key.
platformSetupSteam2Desc: Shown on Account Details, or parse the 17-digit SteamID64 from your profile URL.
platformSetupYoutube1Desc: Google Cloud Console → enable YouTube Data API v3 → create an API key (restrict to this API).
platformSetupYoutube2Desc: Channel ID (UCxxxx) from YouTube Advanced settings, or public @handle. Public data only — no Google OAuth.
platformSetupNetease1Desc: Open your Netease profile; the number after /user/home?id= is the ID.
platformSetupBangumi1Desc: Username on bgm.tv. Public collections need only this field.
platformSetupBangumi2Desc: Recommended for private collections (next.bgm.tv access token).
platformSetupX2Desc: Create an app on developer.x.com and copy a read-only Bearer Token.
platformSetupDiscord1Desc: Add Discord under OAuth login and register the data-platform callback URL.
platformSetupDiscord2Desc: Prefer one-click OAuth; or paste an Access Token manually.
platformSetupMal2Desc: Create an app at apiconfig. Leave empty to use public load.json.
platformSetupXbox2Desc: Sign up at xbl.io and copy the API key.
platformSetupPsn2Desc: Sign in to Sony, open the ca.account.sony.com npsso endpoint, copy the 64-char token.
siteUrlFieldDesc: Click to edit; save applies now and returns a checklist.

domainChecklist.backend_restart_for_cors: CORS hot-reloaded; still sync compose .env CORS_ORIGINS for cold starts

callbackUrlNotConfigured: Please set Site URL in "Basic Config" first
oidcClientSecretPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep current value (*** means already set)
oauthHowToHint: Set the site Base URL in "Basic Config" first — each card below will then show a provider-specific callback URL you can paste into the provider dashboard
oauthSetupFillDesc: Paste Client ID / Secret (and Discovery) into the form below and save.
oauthSetupGithub1Desc: Avatar → Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps.
oauthSetupGithub2Desc: New OAuth App; set Authorization callback URL to the callback below.
oauthSetupGithub3Desc: Copy Client ID and generate a Client Secret.
oauthSetupGoogle1Desc: APIs & Services → Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID.
oauthSetupGoogle2Desc: Choose Web application; add the callback below under Authorized redirect URIs.
oauthSetupGoogle3Desc: Copy Client ID and Client Secret after creation.
oauthSetupMicrosoft1Desc: Azure Portal → App registrations → New registration.
oauthSetupMicrosoft2Desc: Platform Web; set Redirect URI to the callback below. For single-tenant, replace common with your Tenant ID in Discovery.
oauthSetupMicrosoft3Desc: Application (client) ID on Overview; create a secret under Certificates & secrets.
oauthSetupGitlab1Desc: User Settings → Applications (self-hosted: use your own domain).
oauthSetupGitlab2Desc: Set Redirect URI to the callback below; enable openid / email / profile.
oauthSetupGitlab3Desc: Copy Application ID and Secret after save.
oauthSetupDiscord2Desc: Add the login callback; for data-platform one-click auth also add /api/platforms/discord/oauth/callback.
oauthSetupDiscord3Desc: Copy Client ID and Client Secret.
oauthSetupAuthentik1Desc: Authentik admin → Providers / Applications → create OAuth2/OpenID provider.
oauthSetupAuthentik2Desc: Redirect URI = callback below; Discovery like …/application/o/<slug>/.well-known/openid-configuration.
oauthSetupAuthentik3Desc: Copy Client ID, Client Secret, and full Discovery URL.
oauthSetupKeycloak1Desc: Admin Console → target Realm → Clients → Create.
oauthSetupKeycloak2Desc: Valid redirect URIs = callback below; Discovery like …/realms/<realm>/.well-known/openid-configuration.
oauthSetupKeycloak3Desc: Copy Client ID / Secret on Credentials.
oauthSetupAuth0Step2Desc: Allowed Callback URLs = callback below; Discovery like https://<tenant>.auth0.com/.well-known/openid-configuration.
oauthSetupAuth0Step3Desc: Copy Client ID and Client Secret on Settings.
oauthSetupCustom1Desc: Any standard OIDC IdP: Discovery URL, Client ID, Client Secret.
oauthSetupCustom2Desc: Register the callback URL below as an allowed Redirect URI.
oauthSetupCustom3Desc: Copy Client ID / Secret and Discovery from your IdP console.
privateTappInstallCleanupDesc: How long regular users keep private (temporary) Tapps; not site public installs
allowRegisterDesc: When enabled, anyone can sign up at /register. When disabled, only admins can create accounts.
neteasePlaylistHint: Playlist ID from NetEase Music URL, e.g. https://music.163.com/#/playlist?id=2884035
qqPlaylistHint: Playlist ID from QQ Music URL, e.g. https://y.qq.com/n/ryqq/playlist/8039305244
musicProxyEnabledDesc: Relay audio streams through this server. When off, audio loads directly from the music platform's CDN: saves server bandwidth, but may fail outside mainland China and disables the desktop spectrum
musicPreloadEnabledDesc: Buffer the next track after 30 seconds of playback and prefetch neighbouring covers, for faster skips at the cost of extra bandwidth
clearMusicCacheDesc: Clear local music cache to force reload playlist data
musicCacheCleared: Music cache cleared, data will be refetched on next load
permissionsDesc: Configure Tapp elevated delegation and AI quotas. Levels: public / basic / elevated (delegable) / privileged (admin only). Report generation is not delegable
agentPresetDesc: One-click templates for Agent-related elevated toggles; fine-tune below. Does not change media/theme and other unrelated items
agentPresetUserHint: Disabled=off AI/outbound; Chat=ai:chat+analyze; Standard=all AI; Elevated=AI+outbound+scheduler
agentPresetGuestHint: Guests have no Agent sessions; enabling ai:chat mainly affects entry visibility and Tapp AI. Use with caution
agentFineTuneDesc: Adjust elevated toggles on top of Agent presets; changes may show the preset as Custom
userElevatedPermissionsDesc: Grant elevated permissions per toggle; AI/outbound/scheduler can also be set via Agent presets above
guestElevatedPermissionsDesc: Select elevated permissions to grant to guests (use with caution)
permAiGenerateHint: Allow Tapp to generate content with AI
permAiAnalyzeHint: Allow Tapp to analyze data with AI
permAiChatHint: Allow Tapp to use AI chat features
permNetworkFetchHint: Allow declared outbound requests and loading remote images/media
permComponentThemeHint: Allow Tapp to register custom themes
permShortcutRegisterHint: Allow Tapp to register global shortcuts
permEventPublishHint: Allow Tapp to publish events to other Tapps
permAiImageHint: Allow Tapp to generate images with AI
permAiSearchHint: Allow Tapp to search the web (TinyFish, Gemini grounding fallback)
perm3dGenerateHint: Allow Tapp to generate, rig, or retarget 3D models with Tripo
permSchedulerRegisterHint: Allow Tapp to register and manage scheduled tasks
permSpeechTtsHint: Allow Tapp to use cloud text-to-speech service (TTS)
permSpeechAsrHint: Allow Tapp to use cloud speech recognition service (ASR)
permStorageWriteHint: Allow writing to this app’s private storage
moduleSettingsDesc: Who can see each feature, plus library sources, report expiry, music player, and hitokoto
libraryModuleDesc: Set the card layout and choose which platform sources appear in each category
libraryLayoutDesc: Choose the regular list or a draggable canvas extending from the center. Low-end devices fall back to the list automatically
librarySourceVisibleCount: Showing {shown, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} from {total} before filtering
librarySourceNoData: No library source data yet. Fetch platform data first.
librarySourceSaveFailed: Failed to save library source settings
librarySourceLoadFailed: Failed to load library source settings
moduleVisibilityDesc: Set who can see Library, Journal, Platform Reports, Tapp Store, and Agent
moduleVisibilityLoadFailed: Failed to load page visibility settings
moduleVisibilitySaveFailed: Could not save page visibility settings.
hitokotoDesc: Choose a quote source, or set a custom API and sources in other languages
hitokotoCustomUrlHint: Must return JSON; cross-origin requests are relayed by the server proxy
hitokotoTextFieldHint: JSON field name holding the quote text
hitokotoAuthorFieldHint: JSON field name holding the source/author (optional)
reportSettingsDesc: Manage report lifetime and expiry behavior
reportExpiryEnabledDesc: When disabled, existing and newly generated reports remain available
reportAutoRegenerateDesc: Show stale platform reports while regenerating them in the background
reportExpiryDaysHint: Choose 1–365 days. Newly generated reports use this lifetime.
reportSettingsLoadFailed: Failed to load report page settings
reportSettingsSaveFailed: Could not save report page settings.
aiQuotaDesc: Configure AI usage limits for non-admin users (admins have no limits)
userAiQuotaDesc: Daily AI usage quota for logged-in users
guestAiQuotaDesc: Daily AI usage quota for anonymous visitors
aiDailyCallsHint: Maximum AI calls per day (shared across all AI features)
platformEnablePreviewOn: The {name} card will appear on the reports page, in the current drag order
platformEnablePreviewOff: The reports page will hide this card. Already synced data stays.
platformEnablePreviewNeedConfig: Open the card and add credentials before you can turn this on
siteFooterDesc: Configure site copyright, ICP number, and cloud sponsors displayed in the bottom-right corner
siteIcpHint: ICP filing number required for websites in mainland China
siteGonganHint: Public security filing number required in some regions
cloudSponsorsHint: Select cloud provider logos to display in footer
siteFooterCustomHint: Up to 2 custom icon+text rows. Same collapse rules as filing/cloud badges (expanded on home; icon-only elsewhere and on mobile)
siteFooterCustomUrlHint: When set, the item is clickable; leave empty for display only
qqBotDesc: Private-chat Work bot. Turn on and save AppID / AppSecret to connect the Gateway.
qqBotHint: The secret is write-only and reads back masked. Empty clears it. The bot stays offline if the switch is off or credentials fail.
qqBotTestOk: Saved credentials can mint a token.
qqBotTestFailed: Saved credentials could not reach the open platform.
telegramBotDesc: DM Work bot. Turn on and save the BotFather token to start long polling.
telegramBotHint: The token is write-only and reads back masked. Empty clears it. The bot stays offline if the switch is off or the token fails. Do not paste MTProto api_id / api_hash.
telegramBotTestOk: Saved token can reach Bot API.
telegramBotTestFailed: Saved token could not reach Telegram.
qqBotCredentialUntested: Saved credentials have not been tested yet
qqBotOpenHint: Search for the site bot in QQ and open the private chat.
telegramBotCredentialUntested: Saved token has not been tested yet
discordBotDesc: Private-chat Work bot. Turn on, paste the Developer Portal bot token, and the worker connects to the Gateway for DMs.
discordBotHint: The token is write-only; reads come back masked. Empty clears it. Off or a bad token keeps the bot offline. Do not paste the data-platform OAuth access token.
discordBotTestOk: Saved token reached the Discord API.
discordBotTestFailed: Saved token could not reach Discord.
discordBotCredentialUntested: Saved token has not been tested yet
feishuBotDesc: Private-chat Work bot. Turn on, paste the internal-app AppID / AppSecret, and the worker opens a long connection.
feishuBotHint: The secret is write-only; reads come back masked. Empty clears it. Off or a bad credential keeps the bot offline.
feishuBotTestOk: Saved credentials minted a tenant token.
feishuBotTestFailed: Saved credentials could not reach Feishu Open Platform.
feishuBotCredentialUntested: Saved credentials have not been tested yet
feishuBotOpenHint: Search for the site bot in Feishu and open the private chat.
channelWorkHint: After pairing, send a request. Reply yes/no or an option number. Send “停止”, “新对话”, or “当前任务”. If a web page is required, the bot points at that task.
aiVendorApiKeyOptional: Stored for this source only. Choose No authentication if the endpoint does not require a key.
aiVendorSharedKeyConfigured: Configured. This shared key will be sent to this source's Base URL.
aiVendorSharedKeyMissing: Not configured. Once set, this shared key will be sent to this source's Base URL.
aiVendorCustomDesc: Add a provider that is not in the preset list
wallpaperMediaPublishHint: Saving settings publishes this image as the wallpaper.
